title: Sweep stale imminent:true flags on 11 predictions with past-close windows

mode6_target.title: PRED-FIELD-2026Q2 verdict hold + re-check schedule (operator commission)
mode6_target.selection: Only integrated EXP older than 14 days in tracker (deterministic seed=20260723 % 1 = idx 0).

finding: While examining EXP-646 integration in data/predictions.json:PRED-FIELD-2026Q2, discovered that PRED-FIELD-2026Q2 still carries imminent:true despite the test window having closed 23 days ago (2026-06-30). Broadened the check: 11 of 11 entries currently marked imminent:true have already-past-close windows. Nine of them closed 2026-04-30 (84 days past), one on 2026-04-18 (96 days past), one on 2026-05-31 (53 days past), and PRED-FIELD-2026Q2 on 2026-06-30 (23 days past). This is a systematic schema-drift issue, not EXP-646-specific — the `imminent` field is never cleared once a window closes.
operational_impact: The poller's "IMMINENT WINDOW WATCH (next 7 days)" scan reads `imminent:true` entries and (correctly) filters out ones that are already resolved. Because all 11 imminent-flagged entries have past-close windows, today's poll summary reads "only pre-resolved April-2026 entries returned by the scan (PRED-087, PRED-088, PRED-111, PRED-085, PRED-077, PRED-090, PRED-081, PRED-105, PRED-106) — nothing new entering the 7-day window." Verified: the 9 April-2026 entries the poller lists are precisely the 9 April-2026 entries in the stale-imminent set. The scan surface is polluted; a genuinely-imminent future prediction would be indistinguishable from noise. See latest-poll-summary.txt for the affected line.
proposed_fix: Mechanical sweep: for each entry in data/predictions.json where imminent === true AND (test_window_closes||window_close) < today, set imminent = false. No prose changes. No verdict changes. No author_status changes.
ongoing_prevention: Longer-term: either (a) compute `imminent` dynamically at read time from test_window_closes vs today (drop the stored field), or (b) have the poller sweep imminent:false as part of its window-close-detection logic. Not in scope of this cleanup EXP — file as a follow-up tinker/decider design question.
devils_advocate: Objection 1: PRED-FIELD-2026Q2 might legitimately still be "imminent" because its re-check date is 2026-08-15 (24 days away). Response: `imminent` in the current schema tracks test-window-close proximity, not re-check proximity. If a separate "re-check imminent" concept is wanted, it needs a new field (e.g., re_check_imminent) — repurposing `imminent` conflates two things. Even by the re-check reading, the 10 other entries (verdict-set months ago) still fail the criterion.

Objection 2: The imminent flag might be preserved intentionally for historical reasons (e.g., "this was imminent at the time verdicts were set"). Response: (a) 8 of the 11 have their verdict field populated (standard_physics/falsified/recycled/tacit_withdrawal) — the historical fact is captured in verdict_set_at metadata, not by keeping a bool stale. (b) The poller is actively consuming this field for a forward-looking scan; the stale values are actively degrading operational output.

Objection 3: Sweeping might mask genuine imminent flags that should have been cleared but were not, hiding a bookkeeping bug elsewhere. Response: The proposed fix explicitly logs each entry it flips (verdict_notes append or ledger row); the operator can audit whether any of the 11 flips looks wrong. Nothing else in the schema is touched.
kernel_of_truth: The imminent field was a good idea for pre-close prediction attention. The design bug is: no cleanup handler when the window closes. This is a common pattern in event-driven state fields — the setter is defined but the clearer isn't.
routing_notes: Mechanical field-set patch — decider self-apply appropriate. Verification-class review (per PROP-025) — check that the 11 flipped entries match the affected_entries list and no other entries were touched. NARRATE-CITE not applicable (schema cleanup, not prose). Consider chaining a small tests/*.js check that fails when `imminent:true AND test_window_closes<today` (fail-loud on future recurrences).
tests_to_add: A single new test: assert that no entry in data/predictions.json has (imminent===true) AND ((test_window_closes||window_close) < today). Fits alongside existing prediction-integrity tests.
data_sources: data/predictions.json (source of truth for the 11 stale-imminent entries)
monitor/changes/latest-poll-summary.txt (evidence: poller output degraded by stale flags)
